[ENABLE]
aobscanmodule(originalcode_7149,$process,6F 4C C2 4A 88 D4 22 98 F2 DC 64 C7 0B) //unique
registersymbol(originalcode_7149)
label(originalcode_7149Restore)
registersymbol(originalcode_7149Restore)
alloc(codecave,1024)
label(code)
label(return)
registersymbol(unlHarvestFlag)
label(unlHarvestFlag)

codecave:
{$begin_obfuscate}
push ebx
cmp byte ptr [unlHarvestFlag],1
jne @f
mov dword ptr [r13+13C],(float)100
{$end_obfuscate}


code:
pop r13d
readmem(originalcode_7149, 8)

jmp return

unlHarvestFlag:
dq 0

originalcode_7149Restore:
readmem(originalcode_7149,8)


originalcode_7149:
jmp codecave
nop 3
return:



[DISABLE]
unregistersymbol(unlHarvestFlag)
originalcode_7149:
readmem(originalcode_7149Restore,8)

unregistersymbol(originalcode_7149)
unregistersymbol(originalcode_7149Restore)
dealloc(codecave)
